title: office.knowledge-write response
description: The page passed every check and was written, indexed and committed once. A refusal writes nothing: invalid_frontmatter, unknown_template, page_id_mismatch, template_page_exists, missing_section, template_type_mismatch, template_invalid, contact_in_body, page_too_long, policy_without_source or unresolved_cite.

path.description: The page's path relative to the Library.
